LEADER: David Ricks beneficially owned 757,308 shares as of February 26, 2025, marked * (less than 1.0% of the 947,989,151 shares outstanding), so pctEconomic is null; the total includes 81,943 shares owned by a family foundation of which he is a director. He also held 27,941 restricted stock units not distributable within 60 days, which are not counted as beneficially owned. HOLDERS: percent of class is calculated on the February 26, 2025 share count. The Endowment's figure is as of December 31, 2024 (information it gave the company); Vanguard's and BlackRock's are as of December 31, 2023 (per their 13G/A filings) and are therefore stale. The fourth 5% holder, The PNC Financial Services Group (5.4%), is left out: the proxy says 50,000,000 of its 51,153,837 shares are held in the Eli Lilly and Company Compensation Trust, for which PNC Bank is directed trustee. STOCK COMP: the cash-flow line equals the XBRL-tagged total share-based compensation expense ($645.6 million). No broad employee stock purchase plan was recorded.
